content.title: K. Ashok Vardhan Shetty: Dissolution of Justice Kurian Panel in Tamil Nadu
content.caption: A retired IAS officer who was a member of the committee on Union-State relations in Tamil Nadu, K. Ashok Vardhan Shetty, has stated that neither he nor the panel’s head, Justice Kurian Joseph, was informed prior to its dissolution.

slides.heading: Context
slides.text: The government dissolved the Justice Kurian panel in Tamil Nadu without informing its members, including K. Ashok Vardhan Shetty and Justice Kurian Joseph.

slides.heading: Details
slides.text: K. Ashok Vardhan Shetty was a member of the committee on Union-State relations in Tamil Nadu, and he was informed about the dissolution of the panel.
